name: Wallbounce: an up-diagonal dash into a wall and a buffered jump
techNote: A metal floor and a wall (x 220-260). From standing 175 u left of the wall, dash up-right with jump on dash frame 7: the dash reaches the wall on frame 7, past the coyote frames (no super) and inside dashBoostMax * 1.4, so the wall arms wallBouncePossible and the buffered jump is the wallbounce (FixedUpdate's wall branch): endDash without the vertical cap, SpecialWallJump(1, wallBounceMovementLock, up * 220): Velocity (-460, 730), 215 momentum up and 1200 away from the wall (-1169.4 after the tick). Hold left: it peaks at y 515 and is in the finish box (x -500 to -400, y 470-530) on tick 32.
